title: 6-DOF UR arm
subtitle: UR5e
summary: MuJoCo Menagerie's UR5e as it ships (the file bam_arm.cell and gear_backlash's UR study drive): kinematics, link masses and inertias from Universal Robots, every joint at armature 0.1, no friction, no joint zero errors. Calibration finds this arm's joint zeros (what UR's per-robot calibration file holds) and each joint servo's reflected inertia, viscous and Coulomb friction.

sensors.measures: joint angle (the encoder, offset from the link by the joint zero) and speed
motor torque from current (what the UR controller reports)
the flange pose from a tag on the flange, seen by a calibrated external camera

known.note: the controller as the description states it: Menagerie's position servos (kp 2000 / 500 N.m/rad, kv 400 / 100 N.m.s/rad, torque limits 150 / 28 N.m)

schedule.excitation: Fourier series per joint (Swevers 1997): 5 harmonics of 0.2 Hz, 10 s, inside the joint and speed limits

sweep.rule: scrambled Sobol waypoints (one per joint-cube cell, collision-free), toured greedily by new cells per second, straight joint-space minimum-jerk moves, every 10 ms sample clear of the floor and the arm

coverage.function: type_cards.coverage.arm_coverage (4 cells per joint inside the limits: the 4096-cell joint cube)
coverage.rule: share of the joint cube's cells the static poses, the excitations and the coverage sweep (every 50 ms) visit; tool voxels need FK (a marginal, not planned here)

sweep.rule: scrambled Sobol waypoints (one per joint-cube cell, collision-free), toured greedily by new cells per second, straight joint-space minimum-jerk moves, every 10 ms sample clear of the floor and the arm

parameters.name: zero_offset_rad
parameters.nominal_source: the description's joint zeros: no per-robot UR calibration file is given
parameters.method: least squares of FK(q_encoder + offset) on the tracker's flange pose at 40 static poses (Levenberg-Marquardt; 95 % from the Jacobian)

rungs.name: Grey-box residual on M3.wear
rungs.equation: M3.wear + MLP residual (residual joint torques (N·m)) from 3 samples of joint 1 error, joint 2 error, joint 3 error, joint 4 error, joint 5 error, joint 6 error, joint 1 speed, joint 2 speed, joint 3 speed, joint 4 speed, joint 5 speed, joint 6 speed, joint 1 torque, joint 2 torque, joint 3 torque, joint 4 torque, joint 5 torque, joint 6 torque

rungs.name: Arm network (black box)
rungs.equation: MLP over 3 samples of joint 1 error, joint 2 error, joint 3 error, joint 4 error, joint 5 error, joint 6 error, joint 1 speed, joint 2 speed, joint 3 speed, joint 4 speed, joint 5 speed, joint 6 speed → joint torques (N·m)

rungs.name: Ideal: rigid inertia under the board's PD
rungs.equation: J q̈ = kp (q* − q) + kd (q̇* − q̇) + τ_ff − G sin(q − q_bottom)

rungs.name: Stribeck, weakening and capture
rungs.equation: level(v) = Fs − w·min(|v|, limit) − drop·(1 − exp(−(v/vs)²)); the capture level while just slowed

references.title: Armstrong-Hélouvry, Dupont, Canudas de Wit (1994). A survey of models, analysis tools and compensation methods for the control of machines with friction. Automatica.

rungs.name: Rack twin: + cogging, delay, backlash, drive and heat (today's model)
rungs.equation: J q̈ = τ_motor(τ_cmd, delay, current loop, scale) − τ_r(q, q̇) − G sin(q − q_bottom); τ_r = friction level(v) sign(v) + b v + ripple(r q)
